purpose: Teach: プロダクション/自負/特長/館長/主語/一部分/コンセンサス/求む

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪映像プロダクションとの連携もされてますね
lines.en: The police work with crime video production companies too, don't they.
lines.style: Observational, light curiosity. Leaning in slightly with genuine interest. Warm acknowledgment of effort. Conversational rise at the end — not quite a question, more an invitation to confirm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯活動に自負を持ってあたられますね
lines.en: The police take real pride in their crime prevention work, don't they.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, nodding slightly with the thought. Tone steady, respectful. A small warmth underneath — recognizing something good. Soft affirmation on the closing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新たな防犯機器の特長を市民に説明されますね
lines.en: They really make a point of explaining the new security equipment features to the public.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, slightly impressed. Measured pace. Acknowledging effort and clarity. Subtle emphasis on 'new' and 'public' — noting the accessibility angle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪資料館長との連携もされてますね
lines.en: And they work closely with the crime museum director too.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of observation, still warm. Light conversational momentum. A small pause before 'too' — adding another piece to the picture being built.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の主語を明確にされますね
lines.en: They're careful about making the subject line clear in their reports.
lines.style: Practical observation, nodding to attention to detail. Steady, matter-of-fact tone. No edge — just noting competence. Brief, grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の一部分を非公開にされますね
lines.en: Some portions of the statements they keep confidential, of course.
lines.style: Understanding, pragmatic. Light acknowledgment of necessity. No judgment. Tone is calm, accepting of procedure. Slight knowing quality — recognizing why this happens.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査チームのコンセンサスも重視されますね
lines.en: They really value the consensus of the investigation team too.
lines.style: Warm recognition of collaborative approach. Nodding slightly. Gentle emphasis on 'team' — appreciating the shared responsibility. Conversational, admiring without overstating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、特捜隊員「求む」のポスターも見ました
lines.en: I even saw the recruitment poster for the special unit.
lines.style: Lighter shift in energy — small smile in the voice. More personal, less formal. The word 'even' carries slight surprise or amusement. Engaged, present-focused, more relaxed than before.
